description: WeAreTheSwarm event test vectors: events every implementation must ACCEPT. Rules: ADR 0007 and ADR 0010 (strict JSON input, header/body split, body = BLAKE3-derive_key("wats event body v1", JCS(body)), id = BLAKE3-derive_key("wats event id v1", JCS(header)), v1 signature = Ed25519 over "wats/event/v1" || id verified under ZIP 215). secret_key is the 32-byte Ed25519 seed, when there is one.
